prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Lebanese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver ship's anchor, a silver square-sided cowbell, a tin pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum necklaces. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; not thin, not boyish, not evenly proportioned; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Egyptian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a striking young male model face with sharp straight brows, a strong chin and a visible Adam's apple, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, smooth warm light-brown skin, a confident smirk, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, an iron cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold rings. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense folk-art florals filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
